product.description:
Webster’s Collegiate Dictionary — Fifth Edition

A 1946 thin-paper edition from G. & C. Merriam Co., with recessed thumb indexing, gilt decoration on blue-green cloth boards, and a printed portrait of Noah Webster.

Condition

Acceptable vintage condition. No dust jacket. Heavy rubbing, fading and soiling to the cloth, worn gilt, and fraying at the corners and spine ends. Page edges are discolored and soiled. A large section of a blank endpaper has been torn away. The title page has an edge stain, and the contents page shows an edge tear and creasing. Pages show age toning and the hinges show wear. Not inspected page by page; interior completeness and binding strength have not been fully checked. Please review all ten photographs, including the endpaper damage.

Details

  • Webster’s Collegiate Dictionary, Fifth Edition, Thin Paper
  • Publisher: G. & C. Merriam Co., Springfield, Massachusetts
  • Title page dated 1946; underlying copyright 1936; New Words section copyright 1941
  • Based on Webster’s New International Dictionary, Second Edition
  • English-language cloth hardcover; printed in the United States
  • Approximately 8¾ × 5¾ × 2⅛ inches; book-only weight 2 lb 11 oz

Included

One hardcover dictionary. No dust jacket.

Packing & Shipping

Protected against moisture and packed in a rigid box with corner protection. Buyer-paid calculated USPS Media Mail shipping. Two-business-day handling. Returns accepted within 30 days; buyer pays return shipping.
